description: Tells a session what is waiting on the backchannel when it starts, and wakes it when something arrives, so nothing has to be watched by hand.

hooks.command: uv run --quiet --project "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" --no-config --locked --no-dev backchannel hook session-start claude
uv run --quiet --project "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" --no-config --locked --no-dev backchannel hook wake claude
uv run --quiet --project "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" --no-config --locked --no-dev backchannel hook wake claude
